Problem: Fluffy the poodle has arthritis and can't jump. A 5 foot long dog ramp leads up to a 3 foot high bed. How many feet is the base of the ramp from the foot of the bed?

Illustration: Draw the scene I've described, and a right-angled triangle illustrating the relationship between the dog ramp, the height of the bed, and the distance of the ramp's base from the bed. The hypotenuse represents the ramp, one vertical leg represents the height of the bed, and the horizontal leg represents the distance from the base of the ramp to the foot of the bed.
